name: CLIFFSIDE OBSERVATORY PLATFO
text: The entire structure clings to the edge of the
abyss, built from heavy stone blocks and
retrofitted with metal grates. The warm glow
of the lanterns fights back the pervasive

name: UPPER OBSERVATION DECK
text: A raised section of the platform secured by a
metal railing. A glowing star chart and a
scattering of crates suggest it was recently
used.

name: LOWER DECK DRAINAGE GRATES
text: Heavy metal grates are set into the stone
floor to manage runoff. Rusty pipes and loose
gears are strewn about, waiting for repairs.

name: LOWER PLATFORM STAIRS
text: Wide stone steps lead down from the main
observatory level. Weeds have taken root in
the cracks between the heavy blocks.

name: OBSERVATORY RETAINING WALL
text: Thick stone blocks form a sturdy wall holding
back the dirt and protecting the lower
walkway. A rusty pipe emerges from the
masonry, stained by years of drips.

name: LOWER ACCESS STAIRWELL
text: A set of metal stairs descends into the
darkness below the main deck. Caution stripes
mark the edges, though the paint is heavily
chipped.

name: LOWER STAR CHART
text: A dark board displays a constellation map in
glowing blue lines. An open book rests on the
stones nearby, its pages illuminated by the
faint light.

name: BRASS TELESCOPE MOUNT
text: The heavy brass instrument is geared and
counterweighted, pointing up through the open
dome slot. The metal is tarnished but the
lenses remain clear.

name: LARGE STAR CHART
text: A wide digital display board showing complex
astronomical diagrams and orbital paths. The
blue glow cuts through the dim atmosphere.

name: SUB-LEVEL PIPE ACCESS
text: Heavy pipes run along the wall near the lower
stairwell. The metal is dark with age and
condensation.

name: STACKED WOODEN CRATES
text: Several sturdy wooden crates are piled near a
heavy metal cylinder. They look like they
contain spare parts for the observatory's
machinery.

name: LOWER DECK GRATING
text: A section of metal grating covers what appears
to be a drainage channel or ventilation shaft.
A single rusty gear lies discarded nearby.

name: UPPER WALKWAY RAILING
text: A simple metal railing borders the walkway
leading to the small wooden shack. The stone
floor beneath is cracked and uneven.

name: LANTERN POST AND GEARBOX
text: A hooded lantern hangs from an angled metal
post, casting a warm orange pool on the stone.
It's connected to a rusted electrical box near
the edge.
